newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Coca-Cola Co Q2 net rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Coca-Cola Co Q2 net rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTES: Q2 net includes $60 million pre-tax charge for manufacturing facility enhancements in North America. Growth in operating income was also impacted by the sale of consolidarted bottling operations in France, Belgium and east Germany and the stronger dollar.

The company recorded a $200 million gain after-tax in the second quarter of 1997 as a result of the combination of Coca-Cola Bottlers Philippines Inc with Coca-Cola Amatil. This gain partially contributed to the 26 percent increase in earnings per share in the second quarter and the 31 percent increase in EPS for the first half of 1997.
Full company name is Coca-Cola Co.
